scope: Observed development frontier, informational only; never loaded by the planner
selection_rule: highest held-out test accuracy observed on the current code; ties broken by lowest recorded LLM cost

coupon.scheme: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash planner, 12 trials, enable_minilm=true, enable_feature_search=true, stability_repeats=3, seed 42
coupon.gain_over_next_best: +0.08 pt, two extra rows; inside seed noise

headlines.scheme: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash planner, 12 trials, enable_minilm=true, enable_feature_search=true, stability_repeats=3, seed 42
headlines.gain_over_next_best: +0.09 pt, three extra rows over headlines-v6-20261124 (0.697092); validation 0.7032 vs 0.7000
headlines.caveat: gain comes from seven standardized word-level overlap features on top of the char_wb difference vectorizer; five of twelve trials still went to minilm_logistic before the planner reached the pairwise menu, and a fine-tuned MiniLM cross-encoder reached only 0.671 on validation (offline screen), so the ceiling is the linear model plus hand-built pair statistics rather than encoder capacity.

limitations: Released test data was reused during development.
Cross-run reported results are not an unbiased final estimate.
The selected runs use different frozen runtime hashes.
